subject: BrightLeaf MAP: mutual action plan recap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Weston <sam.weston@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightLeaf - Post-call recap & mutual action plan (MAP)

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to keep momentum for the PoC and procurement path.

Key problems you shared
- Multiple teams spend engineering time maintaining on-prem inference and optimizing cost across GPU fleets.
- Latency spikes during peak reporting windows impacting clinician workflows.
- Lack of clear SLAs and observability for model inference (cost + latency per route).

Goals / success criteria
- 95th percentile inference latency under 200ms for 512-token requests in pilot region.
- 30% reduction in per-token compute cost for summary generation workload vs current baseline.
- Auditability: SOC2-aligned logs + 12-month audit retention for the pilot.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level)
1) Technical scoping & PoC kick-off
   - Owner: BrightLeaf (Sam), Redwood (Marissa, Dev)
   - Milestone: PoC plan & test dataset shared
   - Target date: 2027-03-24

2) PoC run (2 weeks)
   - Owner: BrightLeaf engineering + Redwood dedicated support (Dev)
   - Milestone: Latency/cost baseline reports and sample outputs
   - Target date: 2027-04-07

3) Security & procurement review
   - Owner: BrightLeaf security/procurement (Lina, procurement@brightleaf.com) and Redwood security (Rishi)
   - Milestone: Completed security questionnaire, SOC2 evidence, and procurement SOW
   - Target date: 2027-04-14

4) Decision & commercial agreement
   - Owner: BrightLeaf procurement + Redwood sales
   - Milestone: Signed order for Dedicated pilot capacity or Hosted terms
   - Target date: 2027-04-21

Dependencies / open questions
- Procurement timeline at BrightLeaf (target for legal review and PO issuance).
- Access to a representative dataset for latency/cost testing (can be synthetic if needed).
- Any regulatory constraints for data residency (if yes, we will propose VPC/private deployment).

Next steps
- I’ll attach a first-pass MAP spreadsheet and our standard sales deck for your procurement team.
- Can we lock in a 60–90 min technical kick-off on 2027-03-24? Dev is available that afternoon PT.

Attachments: [attachment: BrightLeaf_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)], [attachment: redwood_sales_deck.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
From: Sam Weston <sam.weston@brightleaf.com>

Cc: Lina Cho <lina.cho@brightleaf.com>, procurement@brightleaf.com
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightLeaf - Post-call recap & mutual action plan (MAP)

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. A few quick notes from our side: we remain interested and the goals align well with what we'll need in production.

Quick answers / asks:
- Procurement: Our procurement team needs an initial SOW and approximate pricing bands to start internal approvals. I CC'd procurement@brightleaf.com (they'll route to Legal/Finance).
- Security: Lina will lead security questions; she asked if you can share SOC2 evidence and a short note on data retention controls.
- Timeline: Legal will need 2–3 weeks for review after they see the SOW. Is Redwood able to hold proposed target dates if legal takes that long?

Also happy to lock the technical kick-off on 2027-03-24 afternoon PT — please send a calendar invite.

Thanks — I’ll circle back after procurement confirms next steps.

Best,
Sam
Director of Data Engineering, BrightLeaf Health
sam.weston@brightleaf.com | +1 617-555-9876
